g.text: Frequent content words within each sentiment class
Document frequency avoids counting a repeated word multiple times in the same tweet.
Source: clean_v2 text_norm. Existing lemmatization retained; collection words and technical remnants excluded for this chart only.
Exclusions: stockmarketcrash, bearmarket, user, http, https, www, co, rt, amp. Words are descriptive, not model explanations.
